capabilities: highlight text selections in the Markdown editor
add Word-style comment cards to selected text
locate, edit, reorder, and delete annotations from a sidebar panel
group annotations with drag-and-drop and collapsible groups
extras: Manifest states the plugin currently supports Windows only, while the README mentions iPad and Android touch support. Annotations are stored in article-annotator/annotations.json at the vault root and only appear in editing mode, not reading mode.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach Word-like comments to selected text and manage them in a dedicated panel.

relations.evidence: Modeled After Microsoft Word's Commenting Interface

summary: Annotation plugin that adds Microsoft Word-style text highlighting and comment cards to the Markdown editor, with a sidebar to manage annotations.
